description: Explicit, documented cross-chain match records. FR-06: two chain legs are only joined into one continuous trace when a record here correlates them (e.g. a bridge contract's lock/burn event on the source chain with its mint/release event on the destination chain). Absent a record, crossChain.ts must stop at the boundary.

links.note: Synthetic OmniBridge lock (ETH) / mint (TRON) correlation record used for demo scenario 6.
